MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW (2026-10-15): SPY remains in uptrend (+1.33% 20d slope), providing a constructive backdrop, but the portfolio's track record demands humility — 0W/8L with a Sortino of -14.59 means the strategy has generated pure alpha destruction so far. Every new trade must clear a high bar.

POSITION-BY-POSITION REVIEW:
• AMP (-9.38%, $9,421): Most urgent concern. AMP does NOT appear on the screened candidate list, suggesting its trend/quality posture has deteriorated. At -9.38% from avg cost of $547.12, price is at $495.82 — still above a ~15% stop (~$465) but well into pain territory. Unless the original stop has not been hit, the thesis-break signal (absence from screened universe) warrants a manual review and likely exit at next opportunity. This should NOT be held to zero — if it is not stopped out formally, consider a discretionary exit to recycle capital.
• FOXA (-2.26%): Minor, within normal noise. Not on screened list but drawdown is immaterial. Monitor.
• IT (+6.08%): Working. Not on screened list but position is profitable and thesis holds — let it run with a trailing mental stop.
• NVDA (-0.70%): Essentially flat. Now appearing on screened list as MIXED/SIDEWAYS basing with exceptional fundamentals (ROE 117%, fwd P/E 13.9, rev growth 106%). Existing position thesis intact. No action needed.
• ULTA (+5.61%): Working well. Not on screened list but profitable — continue to hold with a raised mental stop to protect gains.

NEW TRADE RATIONALE: We are at 5 positions (max per strategy), with $22,850 of remaining headroom. Given AMP's deterioration, assuming a near-term exit frees ~$9,400 + remaining cash, capacity exists for one quality add. ADBE stands out as the single highest-conviction setup: fwd P/E of 8.75 and PEG of 0.57 for a business with 62% ROE, $9.3B FCF, and 34.8% operating margins — deeply discounted by the market for AI disruption fears that are increasingly priced in. At 28% of 52-week range and 55 days to next earnings, the risk/reward is asymmetric. Entry is contingent on AMP exit or available cash headroom. One trade only — the 0% win rate demands restraint, not desperation.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $240 or better. Enter in one tranche only. Do NOT chase if price moves above $248 before fill. Ideal entry on any 1-2% intraday pullback toward $238-240 support zone.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Adobe is an extraordinary software franchise — 62% ROE, $9.3B FCF, 34.8% operating margins, 13% revenue growth — trading at a forward P/E of 8.75 and PEG of 0.57. The market has severely de-rated ADBE on generative AI fears (Firefly cannibalization, new entrants), but Adobe's distribution moat, enterprise lock-in, and integration of AI into its own suite argue the discount is excessive. This is precisely the 'wonderful business at a fair price' definition the strategy seeks. TECHNICAL: Price is at 28% of its 52-week range ($193-$360), SMA50 slope has turned slightly positive (+0.8%) after a prolonged base, and the basing pattern is tightening. While ADBE is still -5.7% below SMA200 (not yet a confirmed Stage 2 breakout), the Weinstein framework allows entering a quality base before full confirmation when fundamentals are this compelling. Earnings are 55 days away (Dec 9), providing a clean runway. SIZE: 97 shares × $240 = $23,280 (24.6% of equity, within 25% cap). Risk at stop: $1,407 (1.49% of equity, within 1-2% rule). Contingent on AMP exit freeing capital — do not add if still holding AMP.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) stop at $225.50 is hit (2x ATR, -6.0%); (2) ADBE closes two consecutive weeks below $220 (SMA200 technical breakdown); (3) earnings guidance cut materially at Dec 9 report (revenue deceleration below 10% or margin compression); (4) AI-native competitors demonstrate quantifiable enterprise share loss beyond current expectations. If thesis holds, target hold past 1 year for LTCG treatment. Raise mental stop to breakeven if ADBE reclaims SMA200 and position is up >10%.
